scraped.scraped_description: A free downloadable resource from Digital Charity Lab and ODV Digital, to help you ensure that your organisation doesn’t get locked out of its social media or other digital accounts.

name: Digital Account Management Toolkit
tagline: Free resource to help nonprofits manage social media and digital accounts securely and prevent account lockouts
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Dependent on Digital Charity Lab for ongoing maintenance and updates; limited team capacity for rapid response to security issues

academic_citations.title: Factors associated with COVID-19-related death using OpenSAFELY
Systematic review of research on artificial intelligence applications in higher education – where are the educators?

documented_limitations: Limited to UK and Ireland; resource availability dependent on nonprofit sector demand; no formal evaluation of security outcomes
failure_modes: Account lockout prevention may fail if nonprofits do not follow toolkit recommendations; toolkit may become outdated as social media platforms change security protocols
